name: CodeSnippet

props.name: align
props.description: Specify how the trigger should align with the tooltip

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Specify a label to be read by screen readers on the containing textbox node / ['aria-label']?: string; /** Deprecated, please use `aria-label` instead. Specify a label to be read by screen readers on the containing textbox node

props.name: autoAlign
props.description: **Experimental**: Will attempt to automatically align the tooltip. Requires React v17+

props.name: copyButtonDescription
props.description: Specify the description for the Copy Button

props.name: copyText
props.description: Optional text to copy. If not specified, the `children` node's `innerText` will be used as the copy value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Specify whether or not the CodeSnippet should be disabled

props.name: feedback
props.description: Specify the string displayed when the snippet is copied

props.name: feedbackTimeout
props.description: Specify the time it takes for the feedback message to timeout

props.name: hideCopyButton
props.description: Specify whether or not a copy button should be used/rendered.

props.name: light
props.description: Specify whether you are using the light variant of the Code Snippet, typically used for inline snippet to display an alternate color

props.name: maxCollapsedNumberOfRows
props.description: Specify the maximum number of rows to be shown when in collapsed view

props.name: maxExpandedNumberOfRows
props.description: Specify the maximum number of rows to be shown when in expanded view

props.name: minCollapsedNumberOfRows
props.description: Specify the minimum number of rows to be shown when in collapsed view

props.name: minExpandedNumberOfRows
props.description: Specify the minimum number of rows to be shown when in expanded view

props.name: showLessText
props.description: Specify a string that is displayed when the Code Snippet has been interacted with to show more lines

props.name: showMoreText
props.description: Specify a string that is displayed when the Code Snippet text is more than 15 lines

props.name: type
props.description: Provide the type of Code Snippet

props.name: wrapText
props.description: Specify whether or not to wrap the text.

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon CodeSnippet rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
